summary: The selected launch function pointer is chosen from average row length (width 4/8/16/32). Its subgroup thread-to-row mapping covers the ceiling grid, leaves out-of-range rows with empty intervals, walks each valid row's [offset[row],offset[row+1]) in Width steps, accumulates products, reduces and stores. Main optionally warms the selected function, records events and compiled host increments/compares the actual iteration bound around an indirect call to the selected launcher. Each emitted launcher performs cudaLaunchKernel; final sm86 bodies for all selectable widths retain complete arithmetic and row stores.
